title: Discretization-free exact recovery in geometric community detection
summary: Geometric community detection seeks to recover latent communities in networks where connectivity depends jointly on community structure and continuous spatial geometry. Existing exact-recovery approaches typically discretize the underlying space, which can impose restrictive structural assumptions on the connectivity functions. We develop a polynomial-time, discretization-free algorithm for exact recovery in the Geometric Hidden Community Model (GHCM), operating directly on the continuous geometry.
